sql: select o.id, o.amount from sp.orders o left join sp.users u on u.email = o.email and u.deleted_at is null
plan_off:
Hash Left Join
  Hash Cond: (o.email = u.email)
  ->  Seq Scan on orders o
  ->  Hash
        ->  Seq Scan on users u
              Filter: (deleted_at IS NULL)

sql: select r.* from sp.refs r left join sp.items i on i.name = r.name and i.tenant = 7 and i.active
plan_off:
Hash Right Join
  Hash Cond: (i.name = r.name)
  ->  Index Only Scan using items_tn on items i
        Index Cond: (tenant = 7)
  ->  Hash
        ->  Seq Scan on refs r

sql: select o.id from sp.orders o where o.email in (select email from sp.users where deleted_at is null) and o.amount < 5
plan_off:
Hash Semi Join
  Hash Cond: (o.email = users.email)
  ->  Seq Scan on orders o
        Filter: (amount < 5)
  ->  Hash
        ->  Seq Scan on users
              Filter: (deleted_at IS NULL)
plan_on:
Hash Join
  Hash Cond: (o.email = users.email)
  ->  Seq Scan on orders o
        Filter: (amount < 5)
  ->  Hash
        ->  Seq Scan on users
              Filter: (deleted_at IS NULL)
